name: User Journey Mapping
deliverable: End-to-end temporal visualization of user touchpoints and pain points

steps.text: Agree the persona, the goal, and where the journey starts and ends before drawing anything.
Lay out the stages in time order as columns and name each one from the user's point of view.
Under each stage, record what the user does, sees, and has to use to move forward.
Mark the pain points and the moments where users drop out or need help.
Walk the whole path once and circle the two transitions worth fixing first.

failure: The map lists internal process steps in company language, so it documents how the organization works rather than what the user experiences.
intervention: Ask what the user would say they were doing at that step; if the answer is an internal handoff, move it behind the line and rewrite the visible moment.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A standard service design and UX method; no single documented originator.
